title: Ramblin' & Amblin': Ok, Next Experiment (Revisiting the Dehum Thing)

dimensions.historical_context_at_recording: Recorded while walking underneath 345kV transmission lines in Northern Illinois to empirically test whether LLM-derived DSP audio restoration parameters were a brittle one-off or a general-purpose tool.
dimensions.subsequent_history_and_trajectory: Led directly to the formulation of the Sovereign Verification Framework and the analysis of the uncanny valley in generative AI (the Digital Theremin essay).
